'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Chris Westergard LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Westergard]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

Name as written on the Day 1 sheet.

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
